newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: John Keells up on foreign buying.
newsitem.headline: John Keells up on foreign buying.

text.p: Foreign buying of 100,000 John Keells Holdings Ltd shares pushed up their price by three rupees, or 1.7 percent, to 180 rupees on Friday, brokers said.
"There is regular foreign buying of this scrip because it offers good value at current levels," said a broker with a foreign joint venture broking firm.
The share has good upside potential, since it rose to over 400 rupees when the market rallied in early 1994, he said.
The company is the largest blue chip conglomerate listed in Colombo.
